description: Generated from phase package manifests, detected audio assets, and benchmark-authored audio provenance.

audio.strategy: Locally generated additive piano synthesis rendered into Web Audio buffers; no network or recorded sample assets are used.

generatedSources.name: Stage 4 Phase 1 additive piano voice
generatedSources.source: Original deterministic harmonic synthesis in candidate/src/audio.ts (renderPianoWave), rendered separately per MIDI pitch and velocity-scaled through the live Web Audio gain envelope.
generatedSources.license: Original implementation code; no third-party audio asset.
generatedSources.notes: The tone uses five inharmonic sine partials and a natural decay. This is generated synthesis, not a recording or sample library.

notes: Audio is created only after user note input and routed through one master gain node.
All held sources are released on blur, hidden document, MIDI disconnect, and component cleanup.
No external URL is required for audio or rendering.

audio.strategy: One Web Audio context loads bundled sample recordings for Grand, Upright, and Electric. Clav, Digital, Misc, and sample-load fallback use generated synthesis. Six ordered effects per Piano layer feed a shared rotary modulation stage, layer gains, master gain, limiter, and the context destination.

notes: All 105 selected converted recording files are listed with their path, upstream source file, sampled MIDI root, velocity layer, and size in the source entries above; public/samples/library.json is the runtime inventory.
Selected FLAC recordings are converted to mono Ogg Vorbis at 44.1 kHz and trimmed to no more than six seconds. The app fetches local public assets only.
Electric sample redistribution is restricted to noncommercial use by CC BY-NC 4.0 and requires attribution; commercial redistribution requires a separate license.
The graph uses one AudioContext. Every voice is owned by its input note and Piano layer; sustain honors SUSTPED; all active sources and graph nodes are released on cleanup.
